findings.kind: confirmed developer constraint violation, already reported by root
findings.problem: HOME is repurposed to fresh/home in acquisition/plain/build environments.
findings.required_fix: Inherit existing HOME unchanged; keep explicit fresh CARGO_HOME/RUSTUP_HOME/TARGET and allowed task paths. Do not override HOME/home/CODEX_HOME.
acceptance_constraints: Existing HOME byte value preserved in every child environment
No ROOT/HOME system variable repurposed as task storage
negative_cases: A child environment with HOME changed from original is rejected before acquisition

findings.problem: body=r.read() and body=e.read() assign only after complete reads; a mid-read exception loses the received prefix and finally records an empty body.
findings.required_fix: Stream metadata response bytes directly to publication body incrementally, flush/close on error, hash actual retained prefix, record completion false plus real HTTP status/headers/exception. Handle partial HTTPError body the same way.
acceptance_constraints: Raw bytes already received remain lossless on failure
Incomplete body never claimed complete or parsed/accepted as release metadata
negative_cases: HTTP200 returns a prefix then timeout/IncompleteRead
HTTPError response body returns a prefix then read failure
Zero-byte failure remains explicit zero-byte with failure/completion flag

findings.problem: Source file digest comprehension follows links before the later symlink rejection; root/namespace/package container links are not all rejected before traversal.
findings.required_fix: Validate cache/src/namespace/package containers and every member/parent as regular or expected directory, no symlink/special/escaping path, BEFORE any content digest or archive/member read. Then enforce exact namespace/member/checksum equality.
acceptance_constraints: No external symlink target is opened by a rejected registry tree
Exact232/7607 map and generated markers remain unchanged
negative_cases: Source member link points outside fresh registry
Package or namespace directory is replaced by a symlink
Archive entry/cache file is a symlink or special file

findings.kind: provenance validator gap; no observed incompatibility in saved201 log
findings.problem: Registry source containment is lexical and validates stem only; a path with parent traversal can be labeled an authenticated registry input.
findings.required_fix: Reject parent traversal/noncanonical paths; resolve and require exact approved namespace/stem/member containment and member hash. Generated target sources must remain separately classified and bounded.
acceptance_constraints: Authenticated registry classification is based on canonical approved member identity
No change to actual source23/Cargo target/profile/features/remap recipe
negative_cases: Unexpected namespace or unknown member under a known stem
Legitimate saved201 argv/root relative src/lib.rs still accepted

findings.kind: conditional acquisition constraint after required HOME repair
findings.problem: After HOME inheritance is restored, curl can inherit HOME curl configuration unless explicitly disabled or checked; static argv alone then does not establish effective acquisition arguments.
findings.required_fix: Use curl --disable as its first option, or reject/hash-bind relevant curl configuration before download. Keep exact official URL/asset/SHA/size/retry0 and retain raw response evidence.
acceptance_constraints: Inherited curlrc cannot add URLs/options/output behavior
negative_cases: Inherited curlrc specifies an additional URL or output option
Normal no-curlrc route retains exact archive identity and numeric exit
